#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <stack>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll** ways;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    
    Half(ll match, ll value) : match(match), value(value) {}
    
    bool operator<(const Half& other) const {
        return value < other.value;
    }
};

bool nextCombination(int* a, int k, int n) {
    int ptr = k - 1;
    while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
        ptr--;
    }
    if (ptr < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    a[ptr]++;
    for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
        a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
    }
    return true;
}

ll choose(int n, int k) {
    if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) {
        return ways[n][k];
    }
    return 0;
}

bool test(int mask, int i) {
    return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
}

class Solution {
public:
    ll** ways;
    ll totalWays;
    ll bestDiff;
    ll ans;
    
    Solution() {
        preCalc();
    }
    
    void preCalc() {
        ways = new ll*[61];
        for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
            ways[i] = new long long[i + 1];
            ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }
    
    ll getWins(string s, int r, int c) {
        int curA = 0;
        int curB = 0;
        ll ret = 0;
        for (char cc : s) {
            if (cc == 'A') {
                curA++;
            } else {
                ret += choose(curB, r - 1) * choose(curA, r);
                curB++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    
    ll slow(int r, int c, string s) {
        int len = r + c;
        int* as = new int[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            as[i] = i;
        }
        ll totalWays = ways[len][r] * ways[len][c];
        
        char* buf = new char[2 * len + 1];
        buf[2 * len] = '\0';
        
        ll bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ll ans = 0;
        
        vector<string> good;
        
        do {
            memset(buf, 'B', 2 * len);
            for (int pos : as) {
                buf[pos] = 'A';
            }
            int match = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 2 * len; i++) {
                if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                    match = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            ll winsA = getWins(string(buf), r, c);
            ll diff = abs(2 * winsA - totalWays);
            if (diff < bestDiff) {
                bestDiff = diff;
                good.clear();
                if (match == 1)
                    good.push_back(string(buf));
                ans = match;
            } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
                ans += match;
                if (match == 1)
                    good.push_back(string(buf));
            }
        } while (nextCombination(as, len, 2 * len));
        
        delete[] as;
        delete[] buf;
        return ans;
    }
    
    void update(Half a, Half b) {
        ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        ll diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        ll delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
    }
    
    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half> arr) {
        sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        vector<Half> result;
        if (arr.empty()) return result;
        
        result.push_back(arr[0]);
        for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i].value == result.back().value) {
                result.back().match += arr[i].match;
            } else {
                result.push_back(arr[i]);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    ll solve(int r, int c, string s) {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;
        
        long long maskA = 0;
        long long maskB = 0;
        vector<vector<int>> cnt(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i + 1][0]++;
                maskA |= 1LL << i;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i + 1][1]++;
                maskB |= 1LL << i;
            }
        }
        
        long long lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
        long long lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);
        
        vector<vector<Half>> fst(c + 2);
        vector<vector<Half>> snd(c + 2);
        vector<int> sz(c + 2, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 2; i++) {
            sz[i] = (int)ways[c + 1][i];
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); mask++) {
            int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
            int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];
            
            {
                int samePref = min((int)min((mask & 1) == 0 ? __builtin_ctz(mask) : __builtin_ctz(mask + 1), c + 1), c + 1);
                
                int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
                int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];
                if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                    totalA += samePref;
                } else {
                    totalB += samePref;
                }
                
                ll winsA = 0;
                
                int curA = 0;
                int curB = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }
                
                int exactMatch = 1;
                for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (!test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
            }
            
            {
                int match = 1;
                if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) {
                    match = 0;
                }
                if ((mask & lastA) != 0) {
                    match = 0;
                }
                
                ll winsA = 0;
                
                int curA = btc;
                int curB = compBtc;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }
                
                snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
            }
        }
        
        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
            vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);
            
            int ptr = two.size() - 1;
            
            for (Half a : one) {
                while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) {
                    ptr--;
                }
                if (ptr >= 0) {
                    update(a, two[ptr]);
                }
                if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) {
                    update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    Solution sol;
    
    int r, c;
    string s;
    cin >> r >> c >> s;
    
    cout << sol.solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
